reasons.plausibility: Solid-state friction stir processing to refine microstructure and reduce hot cracking is widely supported, though generalization to all high-value components may have some uncertainties.
reasons.testability: The proposed experiment with direct comparisons against fusion welding and untreated samples, using clear metrics for hardness, wear, corrosion, and cracking, can decisively falsify the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: It provides a targeted, practical approach to surface repair that directly addresses cost, environmental, and performance constraints with a clear evaluation method.
